result.title: TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery
result.summary: Mixed-variable optimization in scientific discovery often requires exploring large combinatorial spaces under costly experimental evaluations, making sample?efficient Bayesian optimization (BO) essential. However, existing BO methods typ?ically rely on structural descriptors to define similarity among categorical variables, implicitly assuming that structural similarity reflects similarity in task performance. In scientific optimization, this assumption is often violated, leading to surrogate representations that are poorly aligned with the optimization objective. To address this limitation, we propose TagBO (Task-aware Graph Bayesian Optimization), a method that integrates LLM-derived relational priors with descriptor-based struc?tural information for mixed-variable Bayesian optimization. Rather than directly using LLM outputs as predictive scores, TagBO treats LLM outputs as a potentially noisy source of task-aware relational priors and extracts coarse ordinal relational signals from LLM reasoning to construct task-aware similarity structures for scien?tific optimization. TagBO then performs constrained Gaussian process Bayesian optimization over the resulting joint discrete-continuous representation space. Ex?periments on diverse chemistry and materials formulation tasks demonstrate that TagBO consistently improves sample efficiency under fixed evaluation budgets across LLMs of varying capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TagBO，将 LLM 输出的关系判断视为可能含噪的任务感知序关系先验，与结构描述符共同构建相似度表示，并在混合离散-连续空间上做受约束高斯过程贝叶斯优化，用于化学与材料配方的样本高效搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「LLM 输出不宜直接当预测分数、需与任务目标对齐」以及用有限昂贵评估决定下一步取点的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 相似度的内容对齐、LLM 监督噪声处理及证据获取与停止的成本权衡存在可供核查的概念联系，属推测性借鉴。
